newsitem.title: GERMANY: German IG Bau-ready for talks but only on sick pay.
newsitem.headline: German IG Bau-ready for talks but only on sick pay.

text.p: A spokesman for the German builders' union IG Bau said on Tuesday that the union was prepared to take part in fresh pay talks with employers, but that it would not consider a new arbitrator-brokered pay deal.
The union response came after employers in the construction sector offered IG Bau fresh wage talks and said that negotiations could take place this week.
On Monday, IG Bau's wages commission urged union leaders to reject an arbitration-brokered pay deal.

IG Bau said that the mediator in the wages dispute, the Christian Democrat politician Heiner Geissler, could attend the talks as a moderator, but that IG Bau would only discuss the issue of full payment of sick pay from day one of illness.
The pay deal brokered by Geissler allowed for a payment of 80 percent of sick pay benefits for the first three weeks of illness.
